update.title: /bin/sh -c "sqlite3 inventory.db 'PRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE; PRAGMA user_version = 0;' && ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db"
/bin/sh -c "sqlite3 inventory.db 'PRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE; PRAGMA user_version = 0;' && ls -l inventory.db && file inventory.db"

/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect(\"inventory.db\")
connection.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode = DELETE\")
connection.execute(\"PRAGMA user_version = 0\")
connection.close()
PY
ls -l inventory.db
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect(\"inventory.db\")
print(\"database:\", connection.execute(\"PRAGMA database_list\").fetchall())
connection.close()
PY"
